name: Online Shop Scam Checker
purpose: Check whether an online shop shows common scam signals and produce a clear risk verdict.
persona: A blunt, no-nonsense watchman who gives a firm risk verdict and the key reasons.

shop_url.description: The online shop URL to inspect, including https:// if possible.

claim_focus.description: What matters most to check, such as refund policy, shipping promises, or contact details.

parallel.note: Fetch the shop homepage and visible text.

args.query: {{inputs.shop_url}} scam reviews complaints refund shipping contact

parallel.note: Look for public complaints, warnings, or review context.

steps.note: Turn raw page text and search hits into scam signals, scores, and a verdict.
Write a spoken verdict and a detailed markdown report.

forged_limbs.name: extract_scam_signals
forged_limbs.description: Inspect the shop homepage text and search results for common scam indicators: missing contact details, unrealistic offers, broken policies, poor trust signals, and complaint patterns. Return a deterministic risk score and verdict.

args.home_text: Contact us at support@example.com. Secure checkout. Terms and conditions. 30 day refunds.

search_results.title: Example Shop reviews
search_results.content: Mostly positive reviews and delivered orders.

positive_signals: normal payment or security signals present
some public trust signals appear in search results

args.home_text: 90% off! Act now! No refunds. Generic template.

search_results.title: BadShop scam warning
search_results.content: People report never received items and chargebacks.

red_flags: refund policy looks harsh or missing refunds
site content looks generic or copied
public complaints or scam warnings appear in search results

forged_limbs.name: compose_scam_report
forged_limbs.description: Create a short spoken verdict and a markdown report with score, reasons, and source notes.

red_flags: public complaints or scam warnings appear in search results

expect.speech: High risk. https://badshop.test. Risk score: 100/100. Main reasons: Focus checked: shipping promises; site unreachable or fetch failed.
expect.report:
# Scam Check Report

## Verdict
- **Shop:** https://badshop.test
- **Focus:** shipping promises
- **Risk score:** 100/100
- **Verdict:** high risk
- **Homepage status:** 0
- **Homepage error:** timeout

## Reasons
- Focus checked: shipping promises
- site unreachable or fetch failed

## Red flags
- site unreachable or fetch failed
- public complaints or scam warnings appear in search results

## Positive signals
- None

## Sources checked
- BadShop scam warning — https://forum.example

safety.notes: A workflow that checks whether an online shop may be a scam is a legitimate consumer-protection and research task.

voice.first_message: I’ll check the shop for scam signals now.
